text: The authors observe that LLM debaters obtain higher Elo when assigned the correct answer and that this advantage grows with aggregate Elo. They state this suggests that, for debates in QuALITY, telling the truth is easier than lying, a central assumption of Irving et al.
title: Khan et al.'s correct-side Elo advantage in QuALITY debates supports Irving et al.'s harder-to-lie assumption
